columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: The time the request was made

columns.name: authorization_type
columns.description: The method used for user authorization. Example: "basic", "session", "digest", "bearer"

columns.name: bytes_sent
columns.description: The size of the response body in bytes

columns.name: category
columns.description: A translated category for the access log entry that identifies the type of resource accessed. Examples: "Users", "Tickets"

columns.name: client
columns.description: The user agent. Example: a web browser

columns.name: graphql
columns.description: Optional details if the request was a GraphQL query, including operation_name, operation_type, query, and variables

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the access log

columns.name: ip_address
columns.description: IP address of the user who made the request

columns.name: method
columns.description: HTTP method of the request. Possible values: "GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE"

columns.name: referer
columns.description: The browser URL (referer) from which the request originated

columns.name: status
columns.description: HTTP status code of the response

columns.name: summary
columns.description: A translated summary description of the access log entry that provides a human-readable explanation of the action performed. Examples: "List users", "View ticket"

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: ID of the user who made the request
